notes: Three co-transmitters joined by «قالوا حدثنا» converge on يحيى: one group and a shared tail (rule 3)
«أن عمر، قال يا رسول الله» : Umar's own words are the saying, so he is the last link after Ibn Umar (rule 6); the second «عمر» is the one in «أن عمر», since «ابن عمر» carries the word first
«- واللفظ لزهير -» and «- وهو ابن سعيد القطان -» are editor glosses: left out
